title: Acute haemoglobin decline and the ST segment: analysis code
description: Analysis code, study protocols and aggregate results for a two-centre, within-patient electrocardiographic study of acute haemoglobin decline and the ST segment (HEEDB / MGH discovery; MIMIC-IV / BIDMC external validation). The protocols were prespecified and internally locked, with dated change logs, but were not registered on a public platform before analysis. No patient data are included.
